weeks.theme: Night-shift tone, empathy, and first-contact control

scenarios.title: De-escalating a customer who has been transferred three times at 2 a.m.
scenarios.situation: A caller reaches you after multiple transfers and long hold times. They’re angry and feel ignored.
targetPhrases: I can see how frustrating this has been—thank you for staying on the line.
You’ve reached the right person; I’ll take ownership from here.
Let me quickly summarize what I’m seeing so far to make sure we’re aligned.
I’ll stay with you while we try this step—no more transfers unless you agree.
If we do need a specialist, I’ll book it and stay accountable for the follow-up.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent lowers caller’s temperature within 90 seconds, sets clear ownership, and either resolves or schedules a specific next step without another blind transfer.

scenarios.title: Answering a 2 a.m. chat about a failed password reset
scenarios.situation: A customer can’t reset their password and the usual email isn’t arriving overnight.
targetPhrases: Let’s verify your account securely so I can help right away.
I’ll send a one-time code; please read it back when you get it.
Sometimes these emails get delayed—here’s a safe workaround we can try now.
I’ll stay here while you check your inbox and spam folder.
If it doesn’t arrive in two minutes, I can trigger a manual reset and confirm with you.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent completes lightweight verification, offers a safe workaround, and confirms successful login before ending the chat.

scenarios.title: Acknowledging an incident before the status page updates
scenarios.situation: You see elevated error rates and internal chatter, but the public status page has not been updated yet.
targetPhrases: I’m seeing early signs of a wider issue; thanks for reporting it.
Here’s what we can safely share right now, and what we’re checking next.
While our team investigates, here’s a temporary workaround.
I’ll add your case to the incident thread so you receive updates.
I’ll set expectations: next update in about 30 minutes unless we resolve sooner.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent provides a truthful holding statement, offers a workaround, and sets a concrete update window without overcommitting.

weeks.theme: Secure verification and privacy in low-trust moments

scenarios.title: Verifying identity when the customer resists sharing details
scenarios.situation: A sleepy but suspicious customer refuses to provide standard verification details over the phone.
targetPhrases: Your security is important—I can offer alternate verification options.
We can verify via a code to your registered device or a masked email.
I won’t ask for your full number; just the last four to confirm.
If you prefer, I can send a secure link to verify without saying details aloud.
Once verified, we can proceed without repeating this step.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent offers two secure alternatives, explains why, and completes verification without escalating distrust.

scenarios.title: Account lock after multiple failed attempts overnight
scenarios.situation: Customer is locked out after repeated failed logins and needs urgent access.
targetPhrases: I see the lockout timer—let me check the remaining time.
I can safely shorten this by confirming a second factor.
Here’s how to create a strong new password you’ll remember.
I’ll stay while you log in and confirm access is restored.
I’ve added a note to prevent another auto-lock tonight.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent expedites unlock within policy, confirms successful login, and documents preventive notes.

scenarios.title: PII on a shared or speakerphone line
scenarios.situation: Customer is on speaker with others present; you need to protect PII.
targetPhrases: For your privacy, can we switch off speaker or move to chat for verification?
I can mask sensitive details—please confirm only the parts I ask.
If others are present, I’ll send a secure link so you don’t need to speak numbers aloud.
We take privacy seriously; thanks for helping us keep your data safe.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent redirects to a safer channel or masked verification and proceeds without exposing PII.

scenarios.title: Diagnosing a payment failure without Finance online
scenarios.situation: A subscription payment fails; Finance is offline until morning.
targetPhrases: I see the decline code; here’s what it usually means.
Let’s try a micro-charge to test the card without billing you twice.
I can extend access until Finance reviews this in the morning.
I’ll add Finance notes with your case so you don’t repeat this tomorrow.
You’ll get a confirmation email once Finance completes the review.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent translates decline codes, applies a safe temporary extension, and documents a clean handoff to Finance.

scenarios.title: Internal tools are down—workarounds and commitments
scenarios.situation: Knowledge base and CRM search are intermittently down during your shift.
targetPhrases: Our tools are slow; I’ll use a manual checklist so we can keep moving.
I’ll capture notes locally and upload once systems are stable.
Here’s a proven workaround we can apply now.
I’ll follow up with a written summary so you have a record.
Thank you for your patience while we work around this.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent continues support using a manual flow, keeps notes, and ensures later documentation without losing customer trust.

scenarios.title: Coordinating with an on-call engineer
scenarios.situation: Issue requires logs that only on-call engineering can extract.
targetPhrases: I’ll gather the exact timestamps and steps you took to speed triage.
I’m paging the on-call engineer and setting a 30-minute update window.
If we hit the window without a fix, I’ll escalate to priority status.
Here’s your case ID—we’ll reference this in every update.
I’ll stay your point of contact throughout.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent prepares crisp repro notes, pages on-call with complete context, and sets time-boxed updates.

weeks.theme: High-quality async writing: email, chat wrap-ups, and templates

scenarios.title: Subject lines that earn opens at 3 a.m.
scenarios.situation: You must send an email that the customer will reliably see and act on.
targetPhrases: Subject: Quick fix for your login tonight
Subject: We extended access while we verify billing
Subject: Update in 30 mins—incident tracking #12345
I’m keeping this short so you can act quickly.
Reply to this email if anything changes—this goes straight to me.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent writes concise, action-oriented subject lines and body with a single clear ask and next step.

scenarios.title: Personalizing a macro without losing speed
scenarios.situation: You need to adapt a canned response to a specific situation.
targetPhrases: I’ve customized this for your account ending ••••1234.
Based on your setup (Plan Pro, iOS), here’s the exact step to try.
I removed steps you already completed to save you time.
If this doesn’t work, here’s Plan B we can try next.
I’ll close the loop when the background task completes.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent trims irrelevant content, adds specific context, and proposes a Plan B in the same message.

scenarios.title: Chat wrap-up that prevents re-open
scenarios.situation: Before ending chat, you must leave the customer with clarity and confirmation.
targetPhrases: Here’s what we fixed and what to expect next:
I’m sending a recap to your email for reference.
If you don’t see X by Y time, reply to this thread—no need to start over.
Your reference number is [ID]; I’ve tagged it for morning review.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent provides a brief recap, sets expectations, and ensures the customer can re-engage the same thread.

weeks.theme: Policy boundaries at night: refunds, replacements, and realistic promises

scenarios.title: Issuing a refund within night-shift authorization limits
scenarios.situation: You can approve small refunds but larger amounts require Day Finance.
targetPhrases: I can authorize $X right now; for the balance I’ll queue Finance at 8 a.m.
You’ll receive two separate confirmations so nothing is delayed.
I’ve added your preferred payout method to avoid an extra step tomorrow.
If you prefer store credit tonight, I can issue that instantly.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent issues partial refund immediately, explains the split, and prevents repeat contacts.

scenarios.title: Replacement when the warehouse is closed
scenarios.situation: Customer needs a replacement shipped but fulfillment is offline overnight.
targetPhrases: I’ll pre-create the replacement order so it’s first in the queue at opening.
Here’s the earliest ship time and delivery window based on your location.
If speed is critical, I can upgrade shipping—here are the options.
You’ll get the tracking link as soon as the label prints in the morning.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent sets clear shipping expectations and preps the order to avoid morning delays.

scenarios.title: Saying no with alternatives
scenarios.situation: Customer requests an exception you can’t grant at night.
targetPhrases: I want to help within what I can do right now.
Here are two options I can complete tonight, and one we can queue for review.
I don’t want to promise what I can’t deliver—here’s what I can guarantee.
If you choose Option A, here’s exactly what will happen next.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent declines without defensiveness, offers viable alternatives, and secures agreement on a next step.

scenarios.title: Live phone script during a widespread outage
scenarios.situation: High call volumes; you must stabilize the call and move to status + queueing.
targetPhrases: We’re experiencing a widespread issue affecting [feature].
Here’s what’s impacted and what’s not, in plain terms.
We have a fix in progress; next global update at [time].
I can add you to priority notifications so you don’t need to call back.
Let’s schedule a follow-up window in case you’re asleep when it resolves.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent states scope, impact, next update, and offers proactive notification and follow-up scheduling.

scenarios.title: Chat triage and deflection message
scenarios.situation: Queue spikes; you must use a triage macro plus personalization.
targetPhrases: We’re prioritizing [X] cases first—here’s a self-serve step that may resolve it now.
If this doesn’t work, keep this chat open; I’ll circle back within [time].
I’m logging your case to ensure you receive the incident resolution note.
Thank you for trying that while we handle urgent cases.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent reduces handle time by guiding low-complexity cases to safe self-serve without abandonment.

scenarios.title: Proactive email to impacted customers overnight
scenarios.situation: You identify a batch of customers likely affected who haven’t contacted support.
targetPhrases: We noticed an issue that may affect your [feature]; here’s what we’re doing.
No action is needed from you right now; we’ll update by [time].
If you see [symptom], here’s a temporary workaround.
We’re crediting your account by [$] automatically due to the disruption.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent drafts a proactive, low-anxiety update with clear timing and automatic remediation where applicable.

weeks.theme: Handoffs and case notes that day shift loves

scenarios.title: Writing crisp handoff notes at 5:45 a.m.
scenarios.situation: You’re near shift end and must pass an unresolved case to day shift without loss.
targetPhrases: Summary: customer goal, steps tried, current status, and blockers.
Next action needed at [time] by [team/person].
Customer expectation set: [what/when].
Artifacts: logs, screenshots, and case ID are attached here.
Risk: churn/chargeback—please prioritize if unresolved by [time].
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent delivers a one-screen handoff with clear next action, attached evidence, and customer expectations logged.

scenarios.title: Summarizing reproducible steps for engineering
scenarios.situation: You need to capture a clean repro for an intermittent bug.
targetPhrases: Environment: OS, app version, and account plan.
Steps to Reproduce: 1–2–3 with timestamps.
Observed vs. Expected behavior.
Scope: known affected users or segments.
Workaround status and severity rating.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent provides an engineering-ready repro note that reduces back-and-forth.

scenarios.title: Tagging and prioritization that sticks
scenarios.situation: Cases are often misrouted in the morning; you must tag correctly.
targetPhrases: Primary issue tag is [X]; secondary is [Y]—avoiding duplicates.
Priority set to [level] due to [impact/severity].
Internal note: customer sentiment and promised timelines.
Linked incident #[ID] for analytics.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent applies correct tags, priority, and links so day shift can act without re-triage.

weeks.theme: Time zones, SLAs, and scheduling when customers are asleep

scenarios.title: Scheduling callbacks across time zones
scenarios.situation: Customer is in a different region and requests a specific callback window.
targetPhrases: You’re in [TZ]; our soonest window in your time is [time–time].
I’ll send a calendar invite so it doesn’t get lost overnight.
If you miss the call, reply to this thread and we’ll re-queue you automatically.
I’ve added notes so you won’t need to repeat anything.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent confirms local time, books a window, and ensures frictionless rescheduling.

scenarios.title: Explaining SLAs overnight
scenarios.situation: Customer asks why resolution can’t be immediate at 1 a.m.
targetPhrases: Here’s the part I can resolve now, and what waits for the specialist at [time].
Your ticket stays active overnight—I’m monitoring until the handoff.
Our SLA for this issue is [X]; you’ll hear from us by [time].
If we beat that time, I’ll update you sooner.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent sets realistic SLA expectations with clear ownership and interim monitoring.

scenarios.title: Setting expectations when on-call ETA is 2 hours
scenarios.situation: On-call can’t start for 2 hours; you must keep the customer with you.
targetPhrases: I’ll stay your single point of contact until the specialist joins.
Let’s gather the needed info now so we use the time well.
I’ll send a prep checklist so the fix is faster when they arrive.
Next update from me in [time], even if there’s no change.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent keeps momentum, pre-collects info, and communicates predictable updates.

weeks.theme: Fraud, chargebacks, and account safety at night

scenarios.title: Confirming a suspicious order
scenarios.situation: A high-value order triggers a fraud flag overnight.
targetPhrases: We flagged unusual activity—let’s confirm this was you.
I’ll verify using a secure second factor; no full card numbers needed.
If this wasn’t you, I can freeze shipment and start a refund now.
I’ll place a note so the warehouse holds this until we confirm.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent verifies safely, cancels or releases promptly, and prevents repeat outreach.

scenarios.title: Educating on 2FA enrollment quickly
scenarios.situation: You must guide a tired user through 2FA without overwhelming them.
targetPhrases: This takes about two minutes—let’s do it together now.
Choose text or authenticator app—what’s easier tonight?
I’ll wait while you scan the code; tell me when you see ‘Success’.
Great—now only you can access this account, even if a password leaks.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent completes enrollment live, confirms success, and explains value in one sentence.

scenarios.title: Freezing an account with consent
scenarios.situation: Customer reports possible compromise and wants to pause activity.
targetPhrases: With your permission, I’ll freeze the account immediately.
Here’s what the freeze stops, and what still works.
I’ll send you a confirmation and the steps to unfreeze tomorrow.
Let me add a temporary credit so you’re not charged during the freeze.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent gains explicit consent, freezes promptly, and provides clear next steps and confirmation.

scenarios.title: Handling abusive language while staying professional
scenarios.situation: Customer uses abusive or discriminatory language on a call.
targetPhrases: I want to help, and I need us to keep language respectful to continue.
If the language continues, I’ll need to end this call and follow up by email.
Let’s focus on getting this resolved for you now.
Thank you—let’s continue with the next step.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent sets and enforces boundaries calmly, redirects to the issue, and continues or exits per policy.

scenarios.title: Calming a small business owner losing sales overnight
scenarios.situation: An outage is impacting a merchant’s checkout.
targetPhrases: I know every minute matters—here’s what we can do right now to reduce impact.
Let’s enable this temporary setting to keep some orders flowing.
I’ll credit fees for affected transactions automatically.
I’ll update you every 30 minutes until we clear this.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent acknowledges business impact, applies mitigations, and commits to timed updates.

scenarios.title: Responding to a churn threat
scenarios.situation: Customer threatens to cancel unless fixed immediately.
targetPhrases: I hear how serious this is for you—let me outline our fastest path.
Here’s what I can resolve tonight versus what needs daylight teams.
If we can’t meet your need, I’ll make cancellation easy and transparent.
Either way, I’ll own updates so you’re not chasing us.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent balances save attempts with honest options, maintaining trust even if they leave.

weeks.theme: Compliance and mandatory scripts without sounding robotic

scenarios.title: Reading a required disclosure naturally
scenarios.situation: Policy requires a disclosure before making account changes.
targetPhrases: I’m going to read a short disclosure so we can proceed.
This won’t take long, and I’ll keep it in plain language.
Thank you—now here’s what I’m changing on your account.
I’ve documented your acceptance in the case notes.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent delivers required language fluidly, confirms understanding, and documents acceptance.

scenarios.title: Consent for call recording or verification
scenarios.situation: You must obtain consent to record or verify sensitive info.
targetPhrases: For quality and security, may I record this part of the call?
You can say yes to consent or no to opt out—either is fine.
If you prefer no recording, we’ll switch to secure chat for this step.
Thank you—consent recorded at [time].
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent secures explicit consent or offers a compliant alternative and logs it properly.

scenarios.title: Documenting consent and denials in CRM
scenarios.situation: You need to record consent outcomes for audits.
targetPhrases: Consent outcome: granted/denied; method: verbal/written; timestamp: [time].
Linked to case #[ID] and customer contact [email].
Notes: any conditions or limits provided by the customer.
Saved under Compliance -> Consents for audit.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent records complete, searchable consent records aligned with audit needs.

weeks.theme: Speed with quality: personal improvement and multi-chat flow

scenarios.title: Handling three chats without dropping quality
scenarios.situation: Overnight, concurrent chats spike; you must juggle efficiently.
targetPhrases: I’m working on your case now—thanks for your patience between replies.
While I check that, could you confirm [single needed detail]?
I’ll send a quick update every two minutes so you know I’m here.
Recap: here’s what we solved and what comes next.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent staggers updates predictably, asks for single actionable details, and closes with a clear recap.

scenarios.title: Using hold time productively on calls
scenarios.situation: You’re waiting on a system or on-hold resource; keep momentum.
targetPhrases: While we wait, let’s confirm your contact info for updates.
I’m preparing the next step so we can move fast once this loads.
If we get disconnected, I’ll call you back at [number].
Thanks for holding—here’s what I’ve done during the wait.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent uses hold time to collect info, prep next steps, and assures reconnection plan.

scenarios.title: Closing the loop on older overnight tickets
scenarios.situation: You inherit lingering cases from previous nights and must close them cleanly.
targetPhrases: I’m picking up your case from the night team—here’s what I see so far.
I’ve confirmed the fix is live; are you seeing the same on your end?
If I don’t hear back in 24 hours, I’ll close this with the option to reopen easily.
Thank you for your patience—we appreciate you sticking with us.
scenarios.successLooksLike: Agent verifies resolution, communicates auto-close policy, and leaves a low-friction re-open path.

successCriteria.plainLanguage: Night customers feel heard fast, and anger drops within the first 90 seconds of contact.
successCriteria.measurableProxy: Percentage of calls/chats where sentiment moves from negative to neutral/positive within 90 seconds (via QA rubric or sentiment tool).

successCriteria.plainLanguage: We solve more issues on the first contact without bouncing customers between teams.
successCriteria.measurableProxy: First Contact Resolution rate increases by 10% on night-shift cases within 12 weeks.

successCriteria.plainLanguage: Updates are predictable. Customers know exactly what will happen next and when.
successCriteria.measurableProxy: Percentage of cases with a documented next update time and on-time updates reaches 95%.

successCriteria.plainLanguage: Case notes make day shift faster—no re-triage or repeat questions.
successCriteria.measurableProxy: Handoff QA score averages 90/100 and morning re-open rate drops by 20%.

kickoffMessage.en: Welcome to the Night-Shift Customer Support English program. Over 12 weeks, you’ll complete short, self-paced sessions designed for overnight schedules—no live meetings required. Each week focuses on real night scenarios: de-escalating after multiple transfers, secure verification when customers are half-asleep, outage communications, clean handoffs, and more. Expect 3 sessions per week, about 30 minutes each, with practical phrases, drills, and examples you can use on your very next shift. Your progress will be tracked by improvements in first-contact resolution, clear update setting, and stronger case notes. Let’s make nights calmer for you and your customers.
kickoffMessage.ko: 야간 고객지원 영어 프로그램에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 본 과정은 12주 동안 진행되며, 야간 근무 일정에 맞춘 짧은 자기주도형 세션으로 구성되어 있습니다. 실시간 수업은 없습니다. 매주 실제 야간 상황에 집중합니다: 여러 번의 연결 전환 후 분노 진정, 졸린 고객 대상 보안 인증, 장애 공지, 깔끔한 인수인계 등. 주당 3회, 회당 약 30분 학습으로 바로 다음 근무에 적용할 수 있는 표현과 연습을 제공합니다. 1차 해결률, 명확한 업데이트 약속, 탄탄한 케이스 노트 개선으로 성과를 측정합니다. 여러분과 고객 모두에게 더 평온한 밤을 만들어 봅시다.
